retrievalProfile.description: A top-down, cluttered arrangement of diner takeout items featuring a prominent green guest check with mixed typography and gritty, high-contrast textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square, top-down composition of a cardboard box filled with wrapped food, plastic containers, and a central green guest check. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and high-specular highlights on foil and plastic surfaces, evoking a 1970s documentary feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping textures of foil, plastic, and paper
Central green receipt as the primary focal point
Circular container lids balancing the rectangular box frame
High contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights
coreInvariants: Muted, warm-toned color palette with a single green accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The green receipt is positioned in the upper-left quadrant, angled diagonally, serving as the primary information carrier.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Three metallic pull-tab lids and two plastic lids form a cluster in the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the high-contrast green receipt, follows the diagonal line down to the circular lids, and then circles the perimeter of wrapped food items.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with objects to create a sense of abundance and messiness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and shadows provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale greens and off-whites from the receipt and plastic lids.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver metallic highlights from aluminum foil and can lids.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark box interior and reflective surfaces.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and gestural marker script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with high weight
Secondary text mimics fast, aggressive marker handwriting
Body text on receipt mimics standard ballpoint pen script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tightly tracked and slightly distorted to fit the paper texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, industrial slab serifs and fluid, messy handwriting.

preserve: The specific shade of mint green for the paper

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down photo of a cardboard box filled with food wrapped in foil, plastic containers with lids, and a blank mint-green guest check angled in the top left. Use harsh, warm lighting with deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy slab-serif black text to the top of the guest check and add messy, marker-style handwritten text in the center and columns, following the diagonal angle of the paper.

verificationChecks: Does the lighting create high-contrast specular highlights on the foil?
Is the typography a mix of heavy serif and messy handwriting?

adjustableVariables: Level of grit and film grain
mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific band names or song titles
Do not replicate the exact logo of the guest check manufacturer

mustAchieve: Tactile sense of materials (foil, plastic, paper)

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic shadow depth under the receipt
Ensure the foil has a metallic, crinkled texture
Verify the handwriting looks manual and not like a repeated font
Confirm the overall color cast is warm and slightly aged
recipe.reuseFormula: Top-down collage of [Object Type] + [Primary Color] [Document Type] + [Lighting Style] + [Texture Overlay]
